Simulate deterministic mathematical fish paths

Source: R/simulation.R
aqt_simulate_tracks.Rd

The random walks are testing fixtures and are NOT biologically calibrated.

Usage

aqt_simulate_tracks(
  n_fish = 5L,
  n_frames = 200L,
  fps = 30,
  dimension = 2L,
  seed = 7L
)

Arguments

n_fish

Positive integer number of animals.

n_frames

Number of frames.

fps

Positive sampling rate.

dimension

Either 2 or 3.

seed

Random seed.

Value

Synthetic aqt_tracks in tank/cm units.
